meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: Claude 会使用 Cirq 编写、模拟和运行量子电路,支持参数扫描、噪声建模、电路编译及 Google 等硬件后端接入,并产出可运行的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当目标是 Google 量子硬件、设计含噪声电路或做量子表征实验时;也适用于构建/模拟 NISQ 电路、参数扫描等场景。

say.text: 用 Cirq 写一个两比特贝尔态电路并模拟 1000 次。
say.note: 返回电路代码和测量直方图。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对比 0.01 和 0.1 噪声强度下的结果。
say.note: 生成不同噪声水平的对比数据。

say.text: 把这段电路编译到 Google 的 Weber 处理器。
say.note: 给出 cirq-google 的接入与运行代码。

howto.what_en: Claude will use Cirq to write, simulate, and run quantum circuits, supporting parameter sweeps, noise modeling, circuit compilation, and hardware backends like Google, producing runnable Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, running quantum characterization experiments, or building/simulating/optimizing NISQ circuits with parameter sweeps.

say_en.text: Write a two-qubit Bell state circuit in Cirq and simulate it 1000 times.
say_en.note: Returns circuit code and measurement histogram.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to compare results at 0.01 and 0.1 noise levels.
say_en.note: Produces comparison data across noise levels.

say_en.text: Compile this circuit for Google's Weber processor.
say_en.note: Gives cirq-google integration and run code.
